property_summary: For any caller and any timestamp where the call's msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, if block.number % 15 != 0 then the correct contract will NOT transfer its balance to the caller (so address(c).balance remains > 0 after the call), whereas the mutant that always transfers will drain the balance for some inputs (making address(c).balance == 0).
change_summary: Always transfer contract balance to sender (remove the if condition), changing when funds are drained and possibly affecting future pastBlockTime observations via state changes due to transfers.
